title: Simpson's paradox: drug and gender
content: Gender affects both treatment choice and heart-attack risk, confounding the observational association between the drug and heart attack. Adjusting for Gender identifies the drug's causal effect.

variables.name: Gender
variables.content: The confounder affecting treatment choice and baseline risk.

variables.name: Drug
variables.content: Drug D, the treatment whose effect is sought.

arrows.because: Gender affects whether a patient chooses Drug D.
The graph includes the drug's causal effect on heart attack.
